 News Flash
 Election Day Operating Schedule for PRCS Facilities – Tuesday, November 3
 Parks, Recreation & Community Services
 Posted on October 27, 2026 
 Loudoun County Parks, Recreation and Community Services administrative offices, senior and adult day centers, and the Franklin Park Performing and Visual Arts Center will be closed on Tuesday, November 3, for Election Day. 
Park administrative offices are closed, but park visitors and nature centers are open at normal hours.
 All community centers, recreation centers, and the Round Hill Indoor Aquatic Center will maintain normal operating hours. There will be no pre-school or after-school programs.
 Find over 60 amenities at PRCS parks and facilities on My PRCS at loudoun.gov/MyPRCS .
